faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers. If you need more help, feel free to contact us.

items.a1: Optimark is an all-in-one AI-powered digital marketing platform that helps businesses schedule social media content, optimize search engine visibility (SEO), and auto-create high-quality copy tailored to their brand voice.
items.q2: Do I need a credit card to try Optimark?
items.a2: No, you do not need a credit card to start our Free tier. You get free token credits every month to try out the AI Content Maker and Content Planner.
items.q3: How does the token system work?
items.a3: Each feature (like generating a caption or doing an SEO keyword audit) consumes a specific number of tokens. Your monthly tier gives you a fresh set of tokens. If you run out, you can top-up at any time.
items.q4: Which social media platforms are supported?
items.a4: Currently, you can connect and schedule posts to Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. We are constantly adding support for more platforms like Threads, X, and LinkedIn.
items.q5: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
items.a5: Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription plan directly from your billing settings at any time with no hidden fees.

hero.title: Smarter Marketing Starts Here
hero.description: OPTIMARK is an AI-powered, all-in-one digital marketing platform developed by UKI — built to help businesses simplify, streamline, and elevate their digital marketing activities in one connected workspace.

who.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Digital marketing today involves many moving parts — content creation, social media, SEO, scheduling, and performance tracking — often spread across different tools and teams.

OPTIMARK helps small businesses and marketing managers run their digital marketing more simply. With AI assistance, users can create content, plan publishing, and manage their marketing work in one workspace — even when the business does not yet have a website or a dedicated marketing team.
From generating content ideas to publishing and analyzing results, OPTIMARK is built to support the full digital marketing workflow — all in one place.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To empower businesses to grow and compete confidently in the digital era by making intelligent marketing technology accessible to everyone — not just large enterprises with big teams and big budgets.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.intro: Our mission is to make digital marketing simpler and more effective by:
items: Supporting faster and more consistent content creation
Bringing marketing tools and data into one connected platform
Providing clear, actionable insights that support better decisions
mission.closing: We believe businesses should spend less time managing tools and more time growing their brand.

thia-rahmani.name: Thia Rahmani
thia-rahmani.bio: Thia Rahmani is a digital marketing specialist focused on Social Media Marketing and Visual Content. She has experience developing content ideas, building social media strategies, and creating visual material that fits the needs of brands and their audiences. At Optimark, Thia contributes to digital content, social media, and visual marketing that help businesses deliver their message in a more engaging and consistent way.

rafi-rizky.name: Rafi Rizky
rafi-rizky.bio: Rafi Rizky is a digital marketing specialist focused on SEO and Content Marketing. He has experience developing search-intent-driven content strategies, SEO optimisation, and informative content that is relevant to its audience. At Optimark, Rafi contributes to SEO content and content marketing strategy to grow organic visibility and build topical relevance.

jonathan-anderson.name: Jonathan Anderson T.
jonathan-anderson.bio:
Jonathan Anderson is the SEO Lead and Editorial Reviewer at Optimark, focusing on SEO strategy, content strategy, and advancements in AI-driven search. He has extensive experience in developing organic search strategies, technical SEO, content marketing, and optimizing content to improve website visibility and relevance in search engines.

As Editorial Reviewer, he is responsible for reviewing and evaluating Optimark content before publication. The review process covers search intent, structure and content quality, topical relevance, on-page SEO, as well as the implementation of AEO and GEO strategies to align content with the evolution of AI-based search.

In carrying out his role, he combines an SEO approach with a deep understanding of user needs and information quality. His focus is to ensure every piece of content published by Optimark is accurate, relevant, well-structured, and provides real value to readers.
